description: Get one compound's reference page: what it is, the dose range studies used, how often, half-life, side effects and how strong the evidence is. Takes a peptide's or GLP-1's name; brand names and aliases work (Ozempic and Wegovy open semaglutide).

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of the page (2000–30000; default the whole page up to 30000).

name.description: The compound's name, a brand name or an alias ("BPC-157", "Ozempic", "tirzepatide").

name: get_peptide
title: Get a peptide's reference page
